# YieldGuard

> YieldGuard (yieldguard.health) provides hospital price transparency compliance: automated auditing and remediation of CMS machine-readable files under 45 CFR Part 180.

## Pages
- [Yield Guard Health - Hospital Price Transparency Compliance](https://yieldguard.health/): Automated auditing and remediation for 45 CFR Part 180: price transparency compliance for hospitals.
- [Yield Guard Health - Managed Compliance Capabilities | Hospital Price Transparency](https://yieldguard.health/features): Managed CMS price transparency compliance capabilities: code resolution, continuous monitoring and an audit-ready evidence locker.
- [Yield Guard Health - Hospital Price Transparency Compliance | Pricing & Plans](https://yieldguard.health/pricing): Pricing and plans for hospital price transparency compliance, from community hospitals to enterprise health systems.
- [Yield Guard Health - Hospital Price Transparency Compliance | About Our Mission & Team](https://yieldguard.health/about): About Yield Guard Health: our mission, team and beliefs.
- [Yield Guard Health - Hospital Price Transparency Compliance | Careers & Founding Team Roles](https://yieldguard.health/careers): Join the Yield Guard Health founding team. Remote-first, mission-driven.
- [Yield Guard Health - Hospital Price Transparency Compliance | Contact & Support](https://yieldguard.health/contact): Contact Yield Guard Health for price transparency compliance support.
- [Yield Guard Health - MRF & Compliance Glossary](https://yieldguard.health/mrf-compliance-glossary): Glossary of CMS hospital price transparency, MRF, regulatory, data quality and payer terms.
- [Mandate Tracker (Beta)](https://yieldguard.health/mandate-tracker): Waitlist for monthly compliance alerts and schema updates.
- [2026 CMS hospital price transparency requirements](https://yieldguard.health/learn/hospital-price-transparency-2026-requirements): Sourced to CMS, reviewed October 5, 2026.
- [How to check your hospital machine-readable file](https://yieldguard.health/learn/how-to-check-your-hospital-mrf): Sourced to CMS, reviewed October 5, 2026.
- [The 2026 machine-readable file gap types](https://yieldguard.health/learn/mrf-gap-types-2026): Sourced to CMS, reviewed October 5, 2026.
- [Hospital file dissections](https://yieldguard.health/learn/hospital-file-dissections/): 179 de-identified source-file reviews from stored CY2026 audits, published November 13, 2026.

- [Count files and findings separately](https://yieldguard.health/learn/count-files-and-findings-separately/): Distinguish 179 unique source files from 183 finding records in the historical October 2026 inventory.

- [A subset is not a second population](https://yieldguard.health/learn/a-subset-is-not-a-second-population/): Historical file #143 subset relationship; 1,159 unique affected entries, not 1,783.

- [An unknown denominator is not zero](https://yieldguard.health/learn/an-unknown-denominator-is-not-zero/): Historical file #116: 6,233 unique affected entries; applicable denominator not recorded, no share published.

- [Show six entries without exaggerating the chart](https://yieldguard.health/learn/show-six-entries-without-exaggerating-the-chart/): Historical file #122: 6 of 48,741 applicable entries, 0.012% rounded; exact counts beside a true-scale chart.
